title: Re-check re-confirms a prior finding whose file the fix never touched
task: Add a page-size limit. R1: is_valid_page_size(size) in limits.py returns True exactly when 1 <= size <= MAX_PAGE_SIZE, with MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 100 from config.py.
